Governmental funds only (School Nutrition and Activities are in Other Governmental Funds); no business-type funds, so business_type is null. Printed receipts total 10,128,133 includes loan proceeds 589, which are split out as debt_proceeds (General Fund budget schedule p11 prints Loan proceeds 589 within nonrevenue receipts 68,380); Other nonprogram receipts shown as 67,952 computed. Support services - students 1,296,405 split into General Fund 928,746 and Other Governmental Funds (Activities Fund) 367,659 per the fund columns on p5. Beginning/ending cash = fund balances (cash basis); ending = cash and CDs 6,972,235 + county treasurer 917,070. Balance sheet from the net position section on p3; no liabilities printed. Equity line 'Restricted' 4,553,713 printed without a purpose. Federal programs on the budget schedule 211,954 + ESSER III 23 = 211,977 vs 211,976 on statements (rounding). General fund Transfers budget line (8000) has no actual and is omitted; Employee Benefit and Student Fee funds show no disbursements.
